items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: It was Jeannette Key(?), who was a woman about twenty... No, she wasn't twenty, she was about sixteen. Beautiful young girl, sitting right next to Kimball, and she's smiling at Kimball and playing

ctx.x: Yeah. And I went out to the Fairgrounds, and they had Guy Kelly come to play. And I had never seen him before, where the hell he had come from. And that was a good sounding band. It was Jeannette Key(?), who was a woman about twenty... No, she wasn't twenty, she was about sixteen. Beautiful young girl, sitting right next to Kimball, and she's smiling at Kimball and playing, and all the time...
Now, Kimball played banjo and she played piano.
